quiz.question: Which statement about NP is true?
options: Every NP problem is solvable in O(log n).
YES instances can be verified in polynomial time.
NP equals all problems with exponential-time verifiers.
quiz.explanation: Definition of NP uses poly-time verifiers.

quiz.question: NP-hard means:
options: At least as hard as the hardest problems in NP.
In NP and has a polynomial-time solver.
quiz.explanation: NP-hardness is hardness with respect to NP.
